rationale: The last 5 candles show extreme incoherence — a sharp drop from 25.74 to 25.06 followed immediately by a violent spike to 25.93 and back to 25.77, with the final candle carrying 311K shares (nearly the entire session volume). This kind of erratic, high-volume whipsaw at the open suggests price discovery is still chaotic and directional edge is absent. The wide bid-ask spread (58 bps) adds meaningful friction, and with an existing working long order already committed, adding another position in the same name during this instability is not warranted.
